function: Learned CNN-LSTM-ANN estimates and predicts receiver position and orientation, and sets liquid-lens focal length and tilt angles: optical hardware configuration, outside the seven areas (p. 7, p. 8).
notes: Excluded for function (code 5). p. 7: "The first block is responsible for position and orientation estimation"; p. 7: "The third block predicts the optimal lens orientation and the focal length"; p. 8: the output layer gives the lens angles and focal length. The learned part localizes the user and tunes a liquid lens at the receiver of an indoor MIMO VLC link, which is not a base station precoder, a beam, or RIS phase shifts, and the detector is classical (p. 4: "We use maximum likelihood detection at the receiver"). BER results exist (p. 12), so results is not the cause.
